content.caption: Training reward curves of PPO and GRPO over 200 steps for the Answer Agent on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct.
content.description: Two side-by-side line charts showing training reward (y-axis, 0.0 to about 0.35) versus training step (x-axis, 0 to 200). Red lines are PPO and blue lines are GRPO. (a) Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: GRPO climbs quickly to about 0.25–0.3 within roughly 20 steps, dips briefly near step 50–60, and then fluctuates around 0.3. PPO starts near 0.02 and rises more gradually, reaching about 0.3 by roughly step 75. It ends slightly higher, around 0.33–0.35. (b) Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct: GRPO rises rapidly to about 0.27 within roughly 15 steps and stays around 0.28–0.3. PPO starts near 0.02, rises sharply around steps 20–40, then increases gradually to about 0.3 by step 200. In both panels the methods converge to similar final rewards, with GRPO converging faster early on.
